test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'CEMENT' is written as 'ECOCPR' and 'HEIGHT' is written as 'JCKEJR'. How will 'FATHER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'CEMENT' is written as 'ECOCPR',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c11165eedbff8a47f70d71ae9c384ecc83fe897bea93b420edcf81f598cc061e.png] 

For, 'HEIGHT' is written as 'JCKEJR',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fbbf16c66c13ee835fff705785e05512dd73a339eae57841a42942adef718d0.png] 

Similarly, for '**FATHER**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbc1b2e6bb8c1bed263c22c795987b5f42caa57b4101184f5334cf53878b1945.png] 

So, **'FATHER' is coded as 'HYVFGP'**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
